diagram_previews.alt: A sphere with centre O, its equator drawn as an ellipse (back half dashed), the north pole N, and two equator points A and B a quarter turn apart; the arcs NA and NB of great circles are drawn in blue and the spherical triangle NAB is shaded, with dashed radii OA, OB, ON and two red arrows at N along the tangent lines, parallel to OA and OB.
